title: Build grading table editor UI in create_v2.html with CSS styling and AI decompose integration
acceptance_criteria: Grading table appears on create_v2.html when 'short' or 'blank' question type is selected

Table has columns: Sub-question Label (text input), Max Score (number input, min 0.5, step 0.5), Strictness (pill buttons: Strict/Normal/Lenient, default Normal), Reference/Key Points (optional textarea)
Add Row button inserts a new editable row at the bottom
Each row has a Delete button (× icon) that removes the row
Strictness pills toggle with visual active state (green highlight for selected, per existing .sq-pill.on pattern in the codebase)

AI Decompose button triggers POST to /problems/new/ai-decompose/ with the problem description; shows loading spinner during request; on success, populates the grading table with returned sub-questions
Loading spinner: CSS animation (pulsing/rotating) applied to the AI Decompose button or a dedicated spinner element (using CSS animation patterns from animation-basics.md)
Grading table data is serialized to a hidden JSON input and sent with the problem form on save
On edit (existing problem load), the grading table is populated from the saved grading_table JSONField
Responsive: table is scrollable horizontally on narrow screens
Styling matches the existing dmoj-green theme and uses existing CSS variables (--admin-border, --dmoj-green, --muted, etc.)
Table styling added to resources/problem_create_v2.css: .grading-table, .grading-table th, .grading-table td, .grading-table input, .strictness-pills, .ai-decompose-btn
